items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: I think it was at Young’s Gap Hotel.

ctx.x: No earlier than that. I’ll tell you when — the summer of ’58 I played up in the Catskills but that was a different, that was a little Jewish hotel with a great band, four of us, three guys from Columbia College, my dear friend Bobby Porcelli, a great alto player, my friend Myron Schwartzman a piano player, and I can’t recall the name of the drummer. But that was the summer of ’58. The summer of ’59 is when that gig that I was talking about came up in the Catskills. I think it was at Young’s Gap Hotel.
